original_test_intent: Read the intended BMC-card FRU through IPMI and BMC Web UI and compare the complete normalized identity to the approved platform record without changing FRU or diagnostic state.
original_method: Have the owner resolve `BMC crad` to an exact device/locator, verify both interfaces target the same SUT and record, capture complete protected FRU output and synchronized UI evidence, validate record integrity, normalize allowed formatting and compare every required field to approved values.
manual_activity: The owner resolves the item label, supplies the exact BMC-card FRU locator and authoritative values; an operator confirms the matching Web UI resource, reviews exceptions and owns the final verdict.
safety_requirements: Retain complete raw output before parsing
Stop on malformed/checksum-invalid data or UI/IPMI mismatch
Never write FRU data to force agreement
Do not automatically retry malformed reads
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and owner-approved BMC-card locator
Capture complete IPMI and UI evidence
Parse all applicable FRU areas and integrity status

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `fru print` is relevant, but `grep -iA6 Card` can select the wrong section and truncates the record; command-line credentials are unsafe and the UI/approved-value comparison is absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected read-only access to capture complete `ipmitool fru print` output for the verified BMC-card locator, then compare all normalized fields to synchronized Web UI and approved records.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates and read-only FRU intent remain; the item typo is preserved for owner resolution and blanket log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a field ledger keyed by verified FRU device and area, retaining raw, normalized, UI and approved values plus checksum/encoding and optionality status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a spelling-dependent substring filter with an owner-resolved device identity and complete three-way evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A six-line Card fragment cannot establish the intended record, complete identity or BMC Web UI parity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC Web UI may rename or omit fields; only approved normalization and explicit exceptions can reconcile those views.

project_override_considerations: The Project must resolve the label and publish the exact locator and authoritative BMC-card record. FRU correction or write operations are outside this read-only case and require a separate recovery-governed workflow.
expected_evidence: Exact target, resolved label, BMC-card locator and approved record
Complete redacted raw FRU output and parser version
Synchronized same-target BMC Web UI capture

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The spelling `BMC crad` is ambiguous input requiring owner resolution, but Items, Procedure, Criteria and Script consistently describe a BMC-card FRU read and Web UI comparison rather than competing test scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Label resolution, an exact locator, approved values and normalization rules are normal owner/package inputs. Execution blocks only if those inputs or protected read access cannot be established.

review_improvement: Prevents a misspelled label and six-line Card grep from being treated as proof of the intended complete BMC-card identity or Web UI parity.
independent_technical_reasoning: `ipmitool fru print` can contain chassis, board and product areas for multiple devices, and a generic Card string is not a stable record boundary. Exact locator provenance, full decoded areas and raw evidence are necessary to detect wrong-resource selection, omitted fields and checksum or encoding defects.
